integrity: The proof separates the infinite symbolic argument from finite checks, uses the source's stated Walsh identity and dual weight-three count as premises, and records a residual risk of an unindexed equivalent specialization.
limitations: The exact multiplicity distribution of the possible quadratic-sum values is not determined for every odd dimension.
The theorem is restricted to trinomial classes (a) and (b).
Finite verification at dimensions 5, 7, and 9 supplements but does not replace the symbolic proof.
scientific_claim: For every odd integer \(m\ge5\), let \(D\subset\mathbb F_{2^m}^{*}\) be the common punctured value set of classes (a) and (b) in Wang–Xiong–Yuan–Qiu–Zheng–He, and let \(C_D\) be its binary trace code. For \(d\in D\), let \(\rho(d)\) be the number of weight-three words of \(C_D^{\perp}\) whose support contains coordinate \(d\), and put \(G_4(d)=\sum_{y\in\mathbb F_{2^m}}(-1)^{\operatorname{Tr}(y^{17}+d y^3)}\). Then \(\rho(d)=2^{m-3}-G_4(d)/8\). If \(G_4(d)\ne0\), then \(|G_4(d)|=2^{(m+r)/2}\) for some \(r\in\{1,3,5,7\}\); hence \(\rho(d)\in\{2^{m-3}\}\cup\{2^{m-3}\pm2^{(m+r-6)/2}:r\in\{1,3,5,7\}\}\). Moreover \(\sum_{d\in D}\rho(d)=2^{m-3}(2^{m-1}-1)\), so \(\rho\) is never constant on \(D\). Consequently the weight-three dual supports are not a \(1\)-design and the code is not coordinate-transitive. For \(m\ge9\), the displayed range is strictly positive, so every coordinate has locality two but the number of two-helper recovery pairs is necessarily nonuniform.
title: Quadratic-sum control of local repair multiplicities in the two newly resolved trinomial trace codes
